g.text: Manually routed. Not a field-installation release.

g.desc: Manually routed. Not a field-installation release.

g.text: 3. Match RFM95W band and antenna. Use RF breakout/coax. Cabinet protocol and isolation remain to be specified.

g.desc: 3. Match RFM95W band and antenna. Use RF breakout/coax. Cabinet protocol and isolation remain to be specified.

g.text: J302 is low-voltage UART only. Cabinet isolation / protocol / fail-safe handback must be specified separately.

g.desc: J302 is low-voltage UART only. Cabinet isolation / protocol / fail-safe handback must be specified separately.

g.text: 2. DS3231SN pads 5-12 -> GND. CR2032 is not charged. MCU and RF regulator outputs remain separate.

g.desc: 2. DS3231SN pads 5-12 -> GND. CR2032 is not charged. MCU and RF regulator outputs remain separate.

g.text: 1. I2C SDA/SCL=GPIO0/1. SPI SCK/MOSI/MISO/NSS=GPIO5/6/7/10. RF reset/IRQ=GPIO3/4.

g.desc: 1. I2C SDA/SCL=GPIO0/1. SPI SCK/MOSI/MISO/NSS=GPIO5/6/7/10. RF reset/IRQ=GPIO3/4.

g.text: P1 - PROTOTYPE REVIEW | header labels identify modules; IC pad numbers identify bare parts.

g.text: Power through U301 onboard USB-C only. Proposed DS3231SN + separate AP2112K-3.3 supply for RFM95W.
